cases.label: 실제 Worker 결과가 기준 합계와 일치하고 원본 배열이 남는다
cases.probe: const workers=[];let terminations=0;const makeWorker=url=>{const worker=new Worker(url);const terminate=worker.terminate.bind(worker);worker.terminate=()=>{terminations++;terminate();};workers.push(worker);return worker;};let controller;let timer;let resolveResult,rejectResult;const result=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{resolveResult=resolve;rejectResult=reject;});timer=setTimeout(()=>rejectResult(new Error('Worker fixture timed out')),2000);try{const values=Object.freeze([1,2,3]);controller=submission.createWorkerAggregator({workerURL:context.workerBase+'sum.js',makeWorker,onResult:resolveResult,onError:rejectResult});const id=controller.submit(values);const answer=await result;observe({id,answer,input:values,state:controller.getState()});}finally{clearTimeout(timer);controller?.dispose();for(const worker of workers)worker.terminate();}

cases.label: 연속 제출의 실제 이전 Worker 응답을 최신 결과로 채택하지 않는다
cases.probe: const workers=[];let terminations=0;const makeWorker=url=>{const worker=new Worker(url);const terminate=worker.terminate.bind(worker);worker.terminate=()=>{terminations++;terminate();};workers.push(worker);return worker;};let controller;let timer;let resolveResult,rejectResult;const result=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{resolveResult=resolve;rejectResult=reject;});timer=setTimeout(()=>rejectResult(new Error('Worker fixture timed out')),2000);try{const results=[];controller=submission.createWorkerAggregator({workerURL:context.workerBase+'sum.js',makeWorker,onResult:value=>{results.push(value);if(value.requestId===2)resolveResult();},onError:rejectResult});controller.submit([100]);controller.submit([2,3]);await result;observe({results,workers:workers.length,state:controller.getState()});}finally{clearTimeout(timer);controller?.dispose();for(const worker of workers)worker.terminate();}

cases.label: 취소 시 실제 Worker를 종료하고 입력을 유지한 채 새 Worker로 재개한다
cases.probe: const workers=[];let terminations=0;const makeWorker=url=>{const worker=new Worker(url);const terminate=worker.terminate.bind(worker);worker.terminate=()=>{terminations++;terminate();};workers.push(worker);return worker;};let controller;let timer;let resolveResult,rejectResult;const result=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{resolveResult=resolve;rejectResult=reject;});timer=setTimeout(()=>rejectResult(new Error('Worker fixture timed out')),2000);try{const results=[];const input=Object.freeze([1,2,3]);controller=submission.createWorkerAggregator({workerURL:context.workerBase+'sum.js',makeWorker,onResult:value=>{results.push(value);if(value.requestId===2)resolveResult();},onError:rejectResult});controller.submit(input);controller.cancel();const cancelled=controller.getState();controller.submit([7]);await result;observe({cancelled,results,input,workers:workers.length,terminations,state:controller.getState()});}finally{clearTimeout(timer);controller?.dispose();for(const worker of workers)worker.terminate();}

cases.label: 종료는 멱등적이며 종료 후 제출·늦은 메시지를 차단한다
cases.probe: const workers=[];let terminations=0;const makeWorker=url=>{const worker=new Worker(url);const terminate=worker.terminate.bind(worker);worker.terminate=()=>{terminations++;terminate();};workers.push(worker);return worker;};let controller;let timer;let resolveResult,rejectResult;const result=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{resolveResult=resolve;rejectResult=reject;});try{const results=[];controller=submission.createWorkerAggregator({workerURL:context.workerBase+'sum.js',makeWorker,onResult:value=>results.push(value)});controller.submit([3]);controller.dispose();controller.dispose();workers[0].dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message',{data:{requestId:1,sum:999}}));let errorName='accepted';try{controller.submit([1]);}catch(error){errorName=error.name;}observe({terminations,results,state:controller.getState(),errorName});}finally{controller?.dispose();for(const worker of workers)worker.terminate();}

cases.label: 누락·비유한 값의 입력은 현재 유효 요청을 덮어쓰지 않는다
cases.probe: const workers=[];let terminations=0;const makeWorker=url=>{const worker=new Worker(url);const terminate=worker.terminate.bind(worker);worker.terminate=()=>{terminations++;terminate();};workers.push(worker);return worker;};let controller;let timer;let resolveResult,rejectResult;const result=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{resolveResult=resolve;rejectResult=reject;});timer=setTimeout(()=>rejectResult(new Error('Worker fixture timed out')),2000);try{controller=submission.createWorkerAggregator({workerURL:context.workerBase+'sum.js',makeWorker,onResult:resolveResult,onError:rejectResult});controller.submit([4]);const errors=[];for(const values of [[NaN],[Infinity],new Array(1),'4',[0.5],[1000001],new Array(100001)]){try{controller.submit(values);errors.push('accepted');}catch(error){errors.push(error.name);}}const answer=await result;observe({errors,answer,state:controller.getState()});}finally{clearTimeout(timer);controller?.dispose();for(const worker of workers)worker.terminate();}

cases.label: 스키마가 맞지 않는 메시지는 무시하고 실제 숫자 응답을 기다린다
cases.probe: const workers=[];let terminations=0;const makeWorker=url=>{const worker=new Worker(url);const terminate=worker.terminate.bind(worker);worker.terminate=()=>{terminations++;terminate();};workers.push(worker);return worker;};let controller;let timer;let resolveResult,rejectResult;const result=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{resolveResult=resolve;rejectResult=reject;});timer=setTimeout(()=>rejectResult(new Error('Worker fixture timed out')),2000);try{const results=[];controller=submission.createWorkerAggregator({workerURL:context.workerBase+'sum.js',makeWorker,onResult:value=>{results.push(value);resolveResult();},onError:rejectResult});controller.submit([1,2]);workers[0].dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message',{data:{requestId:1,sum:'300'}}));workers[0].dispatchEvent(new MessageEvent('message',{data:{requestId:88,sum:300}}));const during=controller.getState();await result;observe({during,results});}finally{clearTimeout(timer);controller?.dispose();for(const worker of workers)worker.terminate();}

cases.label: 실제 Worker의 전송 실패를 주입하면 원래 예외와 종료를 보존한다
cases.probe: const workers=[];let terminations=0;const makeWorker=url=>{const worker=new Worker(url);const terminate=worker.terminate.bind(worker);worker.terminate=()=>{terminations++;terminate();};workers.push(worker);return worker;};let controller;let timer;let resolveResult,rejectResult;const result=new Promise((resolve,reject)=>{resolveResult=resolve;rejectResult=reject;});try{const marker=new DOMException('fixture clone failure','DataCloneError');const errors=[];controller=submission.createWorkerAggregator({workerURL:context.workerBase+'sum.js',makeWorker:url=>{const worker=makeWorker(url);worker.postMessage=()=>{throw marker;};return worker;},onResult:()=>{},onError:value=>errors.push(value)});let failure;try{controller.submit([1]);}catch(error){failure={name:error.name,same:error===marker};}observe({failure,errors,terminations,state:controller.getState()});}finally{controller?.dispose();for(const worker of workers)worker.terminate();}
